alsoGreen.intent: the input stored in the timer before the call

files.src/Delays.il:
PROGRAM Delays
VAR_INPUT
    Button AT %I0.0 : BOOL;
    Sensor AT %I0.1 : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Light AT %Q0.0 : BOOL;
    Confirmed AT %Q0.1 : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    HoldTimer : TOF;
    FilterTimer : TON;
END_VAR

        LD    Button
        ST    HoldTimer.IN
        CAL   HoldTimer(PT := T#300ms)
        LD    HoldTimer.Q
        ST    Light
        LD    Sensor
        ST    FilterTimer.IN
        CAL   FilterTimer(PT := T#200ms)
        LD    FilterTimer.Q
        ST    Confirmed
END_PROGRAM
